decisions.reason: As a simple accessory tied to the installed trailer base, it likely meets modest aspiration levels and requires so little organisational slack that management would usually keep it absent clear evidence of underperformance.

Having survived the early review period and fitting the firm's core trailer capabilities, this box car trailer series would likely be retained because its results are likely at or near aspiration and the firm has no strong reason for problemistic search away from it.

The high trailer cover series complements established trailer products and can be sold and serviced through the existing network, so management would tend to keep it unless recent performance fell clearly below aspiration.
